answer: Ledger-spend distribution matching. Each identity's payment graph is compared against a reference atlas of known Sybil clusters; identities whose transaction partners overlap beyond a calibrated threshold are flagged retroactively. A plume of shared counterparties marks coordinated farms. The rule: flagged identities forfeit accumulated reputation and future payouts. An attacker must sustain distinct, non-overlapping counterparty sets per identity across a glacier of settlement history, multiplying operational cost per identity.
